source.observed: Both short continuation and whole-trip price question fell through to a generic response; no source API search was made in the original conversation.

contracts: A narrow whole-trip price question reads comparable current-version saved plan totals or requests search without requiring an LLM call.
Minor units use declared currency precision; source type, synthetic/test data and reference FX remain explicit.
Unknown totals, foreign versions and expired external components do not become confirmed whole-trip prices.
Saved price replies preserve trip, existing quote and pending question; they create no order and perform no refresh.
Unanswered required facts and pending confirmations take priority over new price search.
Mixed edits, quoted text, hypotheses and component-only cost questions retain ordinary interpretation.
remaining: Actual owner-like conversation with tourist APIs and strong model
